storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape Instagram post comments with text, timestamps, likes, and public author details. Batch post shortcodes and page through replies as available.
storeCopy.intro: Collect public comments from Instagram posts with text, posting times, like totals, and author profile details. Batch post shortcodes and follow available comment pages.
useCases: Community managers can review public replies across several posts.
Researchers can compare comment activity and posting times on public content.
Brand teams can export comments and author handles for moderation workflows.
howToUse: Set `maxPages` to limit comment pages requested for each post.
Use `maxResults` to cap all saved comments in the run.

faqs.question: How do I find a post shortcode?
faqs.answer: Open the Instagram post URL and use the letters and numbers after `/p/` or `/reel/`.
